title: Atlantis as a multi-site Ice Age civilization
summary: Graham Hancock tells of Atlantis as a multi-site Ice Age civilization, about Ice Age at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.
place_text: North America, Azores, Sahara, Amazon, submerged continental shelves

tellings.quote: but I think it was more than one place.

plain: Graham Hancock, a writer about lost ancient civilisations, says on Jesse Michels's podcast in 2024 that Atlantis, the lost civilisation from an ancient Greek tale, was probably more than one place. He suggests it was spread during the Ice Age across sites such as North America, the Azores islands, the Sahara, the Amazon and coastlines now under the sea, drawing on researchers Randall Carlson and Jimmy Corsetti. If so, an advanced worldwide culture existed long before recorded history.
